description: Varve-native multilingual text corpus. Each entry is created through the editor context (application layer), laid out by the canonical snapshot pipeline, rasterized by the live compositor, and round-tripped through serializeDocument/loadDocument. Results are written to reports/text-corpus/<run-id>/results.json (the run id is VARVE_E2E_OUTPUT_DIR, so concurrent runs stay isolated) with the manifest SHA-256 digest.
